All versions

Reading older documents

The idml crate reads documents of older DOMVersions into the 21.5 model. Before a part is read, it is edited by these rules: one for every schema item that an older version has and 21.5 has not, or has differently. They come from crates/idml/schema-upgrades.tsv; idml-codegen checks them against the schemas and fails if one is missing or not needed. Dropping data is reported as a warning. Tests read documents generated from each older schema with the current model.
